claim: An append-only, SHA-256-chained, HMAC-signed event log detects a single edited byte anywhere in its history, not just at the tampered row.

steps.label: three appended entries, nothing touched
steps.evidence: every link, hash and signature recomputed from genesis

steps.label: one byte edited in entry 0, the oldest row
steps.evidence: detected at entry 0, not merely at the tail
steps.note: Verification walks the whole chain, so age is no protection.

steps.label: a careful attacker recomputes the hash but cannot forge the HMAC
steps.evidence: hash check passes; signature check does not
steps.note: Recomputing the hash is free. Signing it requires the secret.
